I am a young man farming here in North Central Nigeria, with my small plot of maize just under one hectare. I intercrop with beans to keep the soil strong and to have something else to eat if the maize fails. I will buy a little urea and NPK from the market when the rains start proper, but fertilizer is costly so I cannot put as much as the extension people say. I save my own seed from last season because improved seed is expensive and not always easy to find in my village, and my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, only calling neighbors for weeding and harvest time.
